name: VIN Cube 3x3 Lite (Magnetic)
description: The VIN Cube 3x3 Lite (Magnetic) is a magnetic speed cube built for cubers who want a light, responsive feel with more tuning range than you might expect from a simpler setup. Standard magnets help pieces click into place more accurately, while the CFRS adjustment system gives you broad control over how crisp, light, or stable the cube feels. With a compact 55.
features: Clean, accurate turning: Magnetic positioning helps pieces align more consistently during solves.
Light and agile feel: The 70g build keeps the cube quick in hand without feeling flimsy.
More setup flexibility: The CFRS system gives you a wide range of feel options, from lighter and snappier to tighter and more stable.
Easy everyday handling: The 55.5mm size feels compact and precise without becoming too small.
Useful extras included: An adjustment tool and cube storage bag add practical value right out of the box.
CFRS adjustment system: Centrifugal force regulation lets you switch between crisp, snappy, and stable turning styles.
